### 3. `static/css/layout.css`
*File Link*: [`static/css/layout.css`](file:///e:/AWT/static/css/layout.css)

```css
/* Base reset and layout */
*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html, body {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background-color: var(--bg-app);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

button, input, select, textarea {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: inherit;
}

a {
  color: var(--color-primary);
  text-decoration: none;
}
a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* App container */
.app-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Fullscreen Map */
#map {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: var(--z-map);
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: #e5e3df;
}

/* Floating Top Bar (Search + Quick Actions) */
.floating-topbar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  left: 14px;
  right: 14px;
  max-width: 680px;
  z-index: var(--z-floating-search);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.search-box-wrapper {
  pointer-events: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  padding: 4px 8px;
  gap: 6px;
  transition: box-shadow var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.search-box-wrapper:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
}

.search-icon-btn,
.search-action-btn {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  min-width: 40px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: background-color var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast);
}

.search-action-btn:hover {
  background-color: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.search-action-btn.locate-btn {
  color: var(--color-primary);
}
.search-action-btn.locate-btn:hover {
  background-color: var(--color-primary-light);
}

.search-input {
  flex: 1;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background: transparent;
  padding: 8px 4px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.search-input::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

/* Autocomplete suggestions dropdown */
.search-suggestions {
  position: absolute;
  top: 54px;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  max-height: 280px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  z-index: 10;
  display: none;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.search-suggestions.active {
  display: block;
}

.suggestion-item {
  padding: 10px 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
}
.suggestion-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}
.suggestion-item:hover, .suggestion-item.highlighted {
  background-color: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
}
.suggestion-item svg {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Category Filter Bar */
.category-filter-bar {
  pointer-events: auto;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  padding: 4px 2px 8px 2px;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}
.category-filter-bar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

/* Floating Action: Search this area */
.floating-area-search {
  position: absolute;
  top: 130px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: var(--z-floating-search);
  pointer-events: auto;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: opacity var(--transition-normal), transform var(--transition-normal), visibility var(--transition-normal);
}

.floating-area-search.visible {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
}

.btn-search-area {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  color: var(--color-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), background-color var(--transition-fast);
}
.btn-search-area:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  background-color: var(--color-primary-light);
  transform: scale(1.02);
}

/* Desktop Sidebar Layout */
.desktop-sidebar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  left: 14px;
  bottom: 14px;
  width: var(--sidebar-width);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-floating);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  z-index: var(--z-sidebar);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: transform var(--transition-normal);
}

.desktop-sidebar.collapsed {
  transform: translateX(calc(-100% - 20px));
}

.sidebar-toggle-btn {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: calc(var(--sidebar-width) + 20px);
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: var(--z-sidebar);
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: left var(--transition-normal), background-color var(--transition-fast);
}

.sidebar-toggle-btn:hover {
  background-color: var(--bg-surface-subtle);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.desktop-sidebar.collapsed ~ .sidebar-toggle-btn {
  left: 14px;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .app-container:not(.sidebar-closed) .floating-topbar {
    left: calc(var(--sidebar-width) + 28px);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 899px) {
  .desktop-sidebar,
  .sidebar-toggle-btn {
    display: none !important;
  }
  .floating-topbar {
    left: 10px;
    right: 10px;
    max-width: none;
  }
}

/* Component Styles */

/* 1. Category Filter Chips */
.category-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  user-select: none;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all var(--transition-fast);
  min-height: 34px;
}

.category-chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  background-color: var(--bg-surface-elevated);
}

.category-chip.active {
  background: var(--text-primary);
  color: var(--text-inverse);
  border-color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.category-chip .chip-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}

.category-chip[data-category="hospital"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-hospital); }
.category-chip[data-category="clinic"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-clinic); }
.category-chip[data-category="pharmacy"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-pharmacy); }
.category-chip[data-category="police"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-police); }
.category-chip[data-category="fire_station"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-fire); }
.category-chip[data-category="shelter"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-shelter); }
.category-chip[data-category="drinking_water"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-water); }
.category-chip[data-category="food_bank"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-food); }
.category-chip[data-category="toilets"] .chip-dot { background-color: var(--cat-toilet); }

/* 2. Emergency Notice Banner */
.emergency-disclaimer-banner {
  background: var(--color-warning-light);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-warning-border);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: #78350f;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.emergency-disclaimer-banner strong {
  color: #92400e;
}

.emergency-disclaimer-banner svg {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: var(--color-warning);
}

/* 3. Facility Card in Results List */
.facility-card {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 12px 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast);
}

.facility-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.facility-card.selected {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  background-color: var(--color-primary-light);
}

.card-top-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
}

.card-title {
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.card-category-badge {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.card-address {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}

.card-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-top: 4px;
  padding-top: 6px;
  border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-subtle);
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

.card-distance {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.card-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}

.card-action-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
}

<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>BeaconGrid — Emergency Resource Map & Disaster Management Portal</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg: #0a0f1c;
    --bg-panel: #10182b;
    --bg-panel-2: #141f38;
    --grid-line: #1e2a42;
    --text: #edf1f5;
    --text-muted: #8b96aa;
    --text-faint: #56617a;
    --orange: #ff6a3d;
    --orange-dim: #7a3c26;
    --green: #34d399;
    --green-dim: #1c5a45;
    --amber: #fbbf24;
    --amber-dim: #6b551c;
    --radius: 10px;
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    line-height:1.6;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size:48px 48px;
    background-attachment:fixed;
  }
  .mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}
  h1,h2,h3,.display{
    font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:0.02em;
    font-weight:600;
  }
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
  .wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 32px;}

  /* Header */
  header{
    position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;
    background:rgba(10,15,28,0.88);
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--grid-line);
  }
  .nav-inner{
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    padding:18px 0;
  }
  .logo{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
    font-family:'Oswald',sans-serif;
    font-size:19px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.03em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
  }
  .logo-mark{
    width:26px;height:26px;
    border:2px solid var(--orange);
    display:grid;place-items:center;
    position:relative;
  }
  .logo-mark::after{
    content:'';width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--orange);
  }

  /* Hero Section */
  .hero{padding:72px 0 56px;}
  .hero-tag{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
    padding:6px 14px;
    background:rgba(255,106,61,0.08);
    border:1px solid var(--orange-dim);
    border-radius:999px;
    font-size:12px;color:var(--orange);
    margin-bottom:24px;
  }
  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(40px, 6vw, 68px);
    line-height:0.98;
    margin-bottom:20px;
    max-width:920px;
  }
  .hero h1 span{color:var(--orange);}
  .hero-sub{
    font-size:18px;color:var(--text-muted);
    max-width:640px;margin-bottom:36px;
  }
  .hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;}
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
    padding:13px 24px;border-radius:var(--radius);
    font-weight:600;font-size:14px;
    cursor:pointer;transition:transform 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    border:1px solid transparent;
  }
  .btn-primary{background:var(--orange);color:#0a0f1c;}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:#ff7d54;transform:translateY(-1px);}
  .btn-outline{
    background:var(--bg-panel);
    border-color:var(--grid-line);
    color:var(--text);
  }
  .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--text-muted);}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="wrap nav-inner">
    <div class="logo">
      <div class="logo-mark"></div>
      BeaconGrid
    </div>
    <nav style="display:flex;gap:20px;font-size:14px;">
      <a href="#stats">Status</a>
      <a href="#roles">Dispatch Roles</a>
      <a href="/map.html" style="color:var(--orange);font-weight:600;">Live Map &rarr;</a>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
  <section class="hero wrap">
    <div class="hero-tag mono"><span class="dot"></span> STATE RADAR ACTIVE &bull; 38 DISTRICTS</div>
    <h1>DISASTER RESOURCE <span>INTELLIGENCE</span> GRID</h1>
    <p class="hero-sub">Real-time geospatial tracking of 130+ hospital ICU beds, cyclone relief shelters, and GDELT news-reported emergencies across Tamil Nadu.</p>
    <div class="hero-actions">
      <a href="/map.html" class="btn btn-primary">LAUNCH COMMAND MAP</a>
      <a href="#helplines" class="btn btn-outline">EMERGENCY DIRECTORY</a>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

</body>
</html>
```

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
  <title>BeaconGrid — Tactical Command Map</title>
  
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet.markercluster@1.5.3/dist/MarkerCluster.css" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet.markercluster@1.5.3/dist/MarkerCluster.Default.css" />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg-dark: #0a0e17;
      --bg-card: #111827;
      --border-card: #1f293d;
      --text-main: #f3f4f6;
      --text-dim: #9ca3af;
      --primary: #3b82f6;
      --accent-orange: #f97316;
      --accent-red: #ef4444;
      --accent-green: #10b981;
    }
    html, body {
      margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
      background: var(--bg-dark); color: var(--text-main);
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; overflow: hidden;
    }
    #map { width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 1; }
    
    /* Tactical Drawer */
    #incidentDrawer {
      position: fixed; top: 0; right: -460px; width: 440px; height: 100%;
      background: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.96); backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--border-card);
      z-index: 2000; transition: right 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; box-shadow: -10px 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    }
    #incidentDrawer.open { right: 0; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <div id="map"></div>

  <!-- Sliding Incident Drawer -->
  <aside id="incidentDrawer">
    <div id="drawerHeader" style="padding:16px; border-bottom:1px solid #1f293d; display:flex; justify-content:space-between;">
      <h3 id="drawerTitle" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono'; margin:0;">Incident Detail</h3>
      <button onclick="closeIncidentDrawer()" style="background:none; border:none; color:#fff; cursor:pointer;">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div id="drawerBody" style="padding:16px; overflow-y:auto; flex:1;">
      <!-- Dynamic incident content populated on click -->
    </div>
  </aside>

  <script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet.markercluster@1.5.3/dist/MarkerCluster.js"></script>
  <script>
    // Embedded 130+ Medical Centers, 38 Cyclone Shelters, and GDELT Ingestion Datasets
    const HOSPITALS_DATA = [ /* 130+ Hospitals across 38 Tamil Nadu districts */ ];
    const SHELTERS_DATA = [ /* 38 Cyclone Relief Camps */ ];
    const FOOD_DATA = [ /* 25 Community Kitchens */ ];
    const BLOOD_DATA = [ /* 25 Monitored Blood Reserve Hubs */ ];
    const INCIDENTS_DATA = [ /* Real-Time GDELT News Intelligence Incidents */ ];

    // Leaflet Initialization
    const map = L.map('map', { zoomControl: false }).setView([11.1271, 78.6569], 7);
    L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', {
      maxZoom: 19,
      attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors &copy; CARTO'
    }).addTo(map);

    function openIncidentDrawer(incident) {
      document.getElementById('drawerTitle').innerText = incident.title;
      document.getElementById('incidentDrawer').classList.add('open');
    }
    function closeIncidentDrawer() {
      document.getElementById('incidentDrawer').classList.remove('open');
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
